record.original_question: Let M be a compact two-dimensional Riemannian manifold and let phi be a volume-preserving diffeomorphism of M of Sobolev class H^s. Does the global two-point boundary-value problem hold: can one find a divergence-free vector field v in H^s(M) with exp_e(v)=phi, and can one find a curve gamma(t) in D_mu^s(M) from the identity e to phi minimizing the L2 energy integral?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a compact two-dimensional Riemannian manifold (possibly with boundary), and let $\mu$ be the Riemannian volume form on $M$. Fix a real number $s > 2$ (so that Sobolev embedding holds), and let $\mathcal{D}_\mu^s(M)$ denote the group of volume-preserving diffeomorphisms of $M$ of Sobolev class $H^s$. Equip $\mathcal{D}_\mu^s(M)$ with the right-invariant weak Riemannian $L^2$ metric, whose geodesics starting at the identity $e$ project, via the Euler–Arnold correspondence, to solutions of the incompressible Euler equations. Let $\exp_e$ denote the corresponding Riemannian exponential map at $e$, sending a divergence-free vector field $v \in H^s(M)$ tangent to $\partial M$ (if any) to the time-1 value of the geodesic in $\mathcal{D}_\mu^s(M)$ with initial velocity $v$.

Given an arbitrary $\varphi \in \mathcal{D}_\mu^s(M)$, address the following global two-point boundary-value questions:

(a) Does there exist a divergence-free vector field $v \in H^s(M)$ (tangent to $\partial M$ if nonempty) such that $\exp_e(v) = \varphi$?

(b) Does there exist a smooth curve $\gamma:[0,1] \to \mathcal{D}_\mu^s(M)$ with $\gamma(0) = e$ and $\gamma(1) = \varphi$ that minimizes the $L^2$ energy
$$E(\gamma) = \int_0^1 \int_M |\dot\gamma(t)\circ \gamma(t)^{-1}|^2\, d\mu\, dt$$
among all such curves?
artifact.status_search_result: The two-point boundary value problem for the L^2 geodesic equation on the group of volume-preserving diffeomorphisms of a compact 2D manifold remains open in general. In 2D the L^2 exponential map is known to be a nonlinear Fredholm map of index zero (Ebin–Misiołek–Preston; Misiołek–Preston), giving partial local/structural results, but global surjectivity of exp_e and global existence of energy-minimizing geodesics between arbitrary endpoints have not been established.

status_evidence.title: Fredholm properties of Riemannian exponential maps on diffeomorphism groups
status_evidence.snippet: In 2D, the L^2 exponential map on the volumorphism group is a nonlinear Fredholm map of index zero.
status_evidence.claim: Provides partial (Fredholm) structural information relevant to the two-point problem in 2D, but does not solve global surjectivity or minimization.

status_evidence.title: Geometric Hydrodynamics in Open Problems
status_evidence.claim: Listed as an open problem in a 2022 collection of open problems in geometric hydrodynamics.

status_evidence.title: Singularities of the exponential map on the volume-preserving diffeomorphism group
status_evidence.snippet: The weak-Riemannian L^2 exponential map is not injective near conjugate vectors.
status_evidence.claim: Shows obstructions to a clean global two-point boundary-value resolution via the exponential map.
